title: 抵达即是团圆
logline: 深夜雨中的城郊公交站，跑了一天外卖的老周和等车的女儿小雨在末班车到来前分享半个凉包子，传递「抵达本身就是团圆」的暖意，落点公交服务守候每一程抵达。

shots.narrationZh: 深夜十一点，城郊站台冷雨飘
shots.narrationEn: At 11 PM, the suburban bus stop is drenched in cold rain.
shots.visual: A middle-aged food delivery man in a worn dark blue windbreaker, with stubble and obvious tired lines under his eyes, squats at the edge of a faded suburban bus stop in heavy rain, with accumulated water on the ground reflecting warm yellow street lights and blurred light spots from the distant elevated road.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉郁清冷，语速舒缓，重音落『冷雨飘』，气息带潮湿凉感，句首稍作停顿，铺陈深夜雨夜的冷寂感

shots.narrationZh: 跑了一天，包子给你留半块
shots.narrationEn: After a whole day of deliveries, I saved half the bun for you.
shots.visual: The 11-year-old girl in an oversized school uniform, carrying an old backpack, walks over to the man, her hair damp from rain sticking to her forehead, and the man breaks a cold steamed bun in half to hand to her.
shots.ttsDirection: 疲惫里裹着温柔，语速稍缓，重音读『半块』，气息软而轻，带父亲特有的憨厚暖意

shots.narrationZh: 父女压着嗓子，说些家常话
shots.narrationEn: The father and daughter talk in low voices about daily little things.
shots.visual: The father and daughter crouch together by the bus stop, talking in hushed low voices, the sound of rain filling the space between them as the girl tucks a strand of wet hair behind her ear.
shots.ttsDirection: 轻缓絮叨，气息压得轻而稳，像怕惊扰雨夜，语气藏细碎日常暖意

shots.narrationZh: 远的地方，总有人等你到站
shots.narrationEn: No matter how far the road is, someone will wait for you to arrive.
shots.visual: The two look up in unison as bright bus headlights approach from the far end of the road, the light gradually illuminating the rainy station platform.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪轻扬，语速稍快，重音读『等你到站』，气息带盼到头的惊喜上扬感

shots.narrationZh: 再远的路，抵达就是团圆
shots.narrationEn: No matter how far the journey, arriving itself is a reunion.
shots.visual: The interior of the late-night bus, with empty seats, cold white ceiling lights, and rain streaks on the window reflecting the silhouettes of the father and daughter, with the brand slogan 'XX Bus, guarding every arrival' displayed at the bottom of the frame.
shots.ttsDirection: 舒展温软，语速放缓，重音读『团圆』，气息带释然的柔，余味暖而踏实
